propositions: BindingStore.set_baseline unconditionally wrote baseline_advanced_at timestamps that were never read in production, causing pathological git delta churn (1,144 stamp changes across 40 revisions in an 18 MB file).
Consecutive reconciler passes over unchanged Jira state must preserve byte-identical bindings.json and suppress commit creation.
set_baseline must filter five mirrored fields, preserve null baseline values, and return early when the stored baseline is already equal to the new value.
No production code path reads baseline_advanced_at; the field must be absent from all new baseline writes.
Baseline value changes must persist to serialized bytes while unchanged values must preserve byte-identity, guarding against degenerate never-write behavior.
